Now event error tests. Let me write a script that starts a stream and sends bad requests, checking for `{"error":"event"}` and exit code 2, and that earlier responses remain.

Also test that a fatal error emits no partial events for the failing request (e.g., a chunk whose last packet is invalid → no events at all).

Also check exit code 0 on EOF.

Let me write it.

cat > /workspace/tmp/t2/errevent.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, os, tempfile
MAIN = "/app/submission/main.py"
CFG = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":2,"packet_limit":3,"prefix_width":2,
 "rules":[{"id":1,"class":5,"priority":1,"ranges":[[1,3]]},{"id":2,"class":6,"priority":2,"ranges":[[1,3]]}],
 "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}

d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/workspace/tmp")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "compile"], input=json.dumps(CFG).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
prog = os.path.join(d, "p.json")
open(prog, "wb").write(p.stdout)

FAILS = []
def run(reqs, expect_last_error=True, note=""):
    pr = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "stream", prog],
                          stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=d)
    outs = []
    for r in reqs:
        pr.stdin.write((json.dumps(r) if not isinstance(r, str) else r).encode() + b"\n")
        pr.stdin.flush()
        line = pr.stdout.readline()
        try:
            outs.append(json.loads(line))
        except Exception:
            outs.append(("RAW", line))
    pr.stdin.close()
    tail = pr.stdout.read()
    rc = pr.wait()
    return outs, tail, rc

def check(name, reqs, want_error=True, want_rc=2):
    outs, tail, rc = run(reqs)
    ok = True
    if want_error:
        ok = outs and outs[-1] == {"error": "event"} and rc == 2 and not tail
    else:
        ok = rc == 0 and not tail
    if not ok:
        FAILS.append(name)
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name, "" if ok else (outs, tail, rc))

GOOD = [{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}]
check("eof exit0", GOOD, want_error=False)
check("blank line", GOOD + ["   "])
check("empty line", GOOD + [""])
check("malformed json", GOOD + ["{\"op\":"])
check("not object", GOOD + ["[1]"])
check("unknown op", GOOD + [{"op":"nope"}])
check("op missing", GOOD + [{"flow":1}])
check("op extra key", GOOD + [{"op":"tick","time":1,"x":2}])
check("op not str", GOOD + [{"op":5}])
check("tick no time", GOOD + [{"op":"tick"}])
check("tick float time", GOOD + [{"op":"tick","time":1.5}])
check("tick bool time", GOOD + [{"op":"tick","time":True}])
check("tick neg time", GOOD + [{"op":"tick","time":-1}])
check("tick big time", GOOD + [{"op":"tick","time":2**53}])
check("tick decreasing", GOOD + [{"op":"tick","time":1},{"op":"tick","time":0}])
check("open dup", GOOD + [{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1}])
check("open neg flow", GOOD + [{"op":"open","flow":-1,"time":1}])
check("open huge flow", GOOD + [{"op":"open","flow":2**31,"time":1}])
check("open decreasing", GOOD + [{"op":"open","flow":2,"time":0}] and [{"op":"tick","time":5},{"op":"open","flow":2,"time":4}])
check("close absent", GOOD + [{"op":"close","flow":9,"time":1}])
check("close no flow", GOOD + [{"op":"close","time":1}])
check("chunk extra key", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[],"x":1}])
check("chunk packets not list", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":{}}])
check("chunk pkt missing", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0}]}])
check("chunk pkt extra", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":1,"z":0}]}])
check("chunk absent flow", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":7,"time":1,"source":0,"length":1}]}])
check("chunk bad source", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":2,"length":1}]}])
check("chunk neg length", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":0}]}])
check("chunk big length", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":2049}]}])
check("chunk dec time inside", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":5,"source":0,"length":1},{"flow":1,"time":4,"source":0,"length":1}]}])
check("chunk dec vs global", GOOD + [{"op":"tick","time":5},{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":4,"source":0,"length":1}]}])
check("chunk no partial events", [{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":2},{"flow":1,"time":2,"source":0,"length":9}]}])
check("restore not first", GOOD + [{"op":"restore","checkpoint":{}}])
check("restore no val", [{"op":"restore"}])
check("checkpoint extra", GOOD + [{"op":"checkpoint","x":1}])
check("flow bool", GOOD + [{"op":"close","flow":True,"time":1}])
# valid sequences still fine
check("valid seq exit0", GOOD + [{"op":"chunk","packets":[]},{"op":"tick","time":3},{"op":"close","flow":1,"time":4}], want_error=False)
# 4097 flows -> excess
many = [{"op":"open","flow":i,"time":0} for i in range(4097)]
check("too many flows", many)
print("FAILS:", FAILS)
PYEOF
